code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]

        bounds = [-1] + cuts + [n]
        return [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(bounds, bounds[1:]) if a + 1 < b]
    rs, cs = segments(h, rows), segments(w, cols)
    # Select the region containing the non-background pattern, then tile it everywhere.
    seed = None
    for r0, r1 in rs:
        for c0, c1 in cs:
            if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)):
                seed = (r0, r1, c0, c1)
                break
        if seed: break
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = seed
    th, tw = r1-r0, c1-c0
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ar, (y0, y1) in enumerate(rs):
